# RAG Patterns with Vector Search — facts

> Source-anchored units about RAG Patterns with Vector Search: 20 across 4 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-23 · 20 units · 4 sources · rights: quote -->

## Definitions

- [statement] More retrieved context is not automatically better evidence use. Lost in the Middle found position-sensitive failures in the models it tested; a 2026 reproducibility study found that ordering and context-size effects interact with model choice, retrieval quality, and evaluation sampling. (medium confidence) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172 · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search · also: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27105

## How it works

- [statement] Contextual Retrieval prepends chunk-specific document context before embedding and BM25 indexing to preserve information lost when chunks stand alone. (low confidence) — https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] An independent experiment with 35 blog documents and 15 questions reported document-level Hit@1 of 1.000 for dense and hybrid retrieval but 0.867 after adding its cross-encoder; its tiny, easy benchmark and absence of answer generation limit generalization. (low confidence) — https://github.com/alexsavio/rag-eval/blob/main/docs/01-hybrid-vs-rerank.md · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search
- [statement] Anthropic reported top-20 retrieval failure falling from 5.7% to 2.9% with contextual embeddings plus contextual BM25, and to 1.9% with reranking; these are experimental retrieval results, not universal answer-accuracy gains. (low confidence) — https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] A two-stage pattern retrieves a larger candidate pool, reranks query–chunk pairs, and sends a smaller selected set to the generator. The extra scoring step introduces a quality, latency, and cost trade-off. (low confidence) — https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search
- [statement] MongoDB's document-intelligence reference architecture illustrates corrective RAG with a retrieval agent, document grader, and query rewriter. Conditional graph edges retry retrieval after relevance checks fail; this is an implementation pattern rather than measured proof of higher accuracy. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/solutions-library/document-intelligence.md · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search

## Facts and statements

- [statement] RAG retrieves relevant external text before generation. With Atlas Vector Search, an application stores document embeddings, embeds the query, retrieves matching documents, and supplies their text to the language model. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/about/use-cases.md · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/crud-embeddings/create-embeddings-manual/, https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval
- [statement] Hybrid retrieval combines semantic candidates with lexical candidates and fuses their rankings. This is useful for identifiers and proper nouns that semantic similarity alone can miss; the MongoDB example uses RRF over $vectorSearch and $search. (high confidence) — https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search · also: https://github.com/mongodb-partners/mongodb-langchain-agentic-ai/blob/main/README.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview.md
- [statement] Treat hybrid retrieval and reranking as hypotheses to evaluate. Anthropic reported improvements on its datasets, while a separate small-corpus experiment reported reranking regressions; neither result establishes a universal best pipeline for an Atlas application. (medium confidence) — https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search · also: https://github.com/alexsavio/rag-eval/blob/main/docs/01-hybrid-vs-rerank.md
- [statement] For multi-turn RAG, MongoDB's reference architecture stores conversation checkpoints in a dedicated collection. It also demonstrates section-specific retrieval prompts for scheduled reports, so different report sections can retrieve different evidence. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/solutions-library/document-intelligence.md · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search
- [statement] In manually embedded pipelines, verify that query embeddings, stored embeddings, and the vector index have matching dimensions. Test embedding generation on a small subset, batch larger ingestion jobs, and evaluate result relevance before scaling. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/crud-embeddings/create-embeddings-manual/ · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search
- [statement] The MongoDB example repository forwards a source constraint as a server-side pre_filter on an indexed filter field. This illustrates narrowing retrieval by metadata; the example does not establish an application-wide authorization policy. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb-partners/mongodb-langchain-agentic-ai/blob/main/README.md · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search
- [statement] MongoDB's local RAG tutorial separates local embedding generation, vector indexing, retrieval, and local answer generation. It explicitly scopes local Atlas deployments to testing and directs production users to deploy a cluster. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/tutorials/local-rag/ · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search
- [statement] RAG combines a language model with custom data by retrieving relevant context before generating a response; MongoDB documents this as a Vector Search application pattern. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/about/use-cases.md · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search · also: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval
- [statement] A baseline pipeline splits documents into chunks, embeds them, retrieves semantically similar chunks for a query, and supplies retrieved text to the generator. (medium confidence) — https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search · also: https://github.com/alexsavio/rag-eval/blob/main/docs/01-hybrid-vs-rerank.md
- [statement] MongoDB documents $rankFusion for reciprocal-rank fusion of $vectorSearch and $search results, and $scoreFusion for combining normalized relevance scores. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview.md · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search
- [statement] MongoDB documents a shared-collection constraint for fusion sub-pipelines, serial execution, and no pagination; cross-collection retrieval requires a different construction such as $unionWith. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview.md · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search
- [statement] Retrieving a candidate pool and reranking it before selecting final context is a separate stage from first-stage hybrid fusion. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview.md · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search · also: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval, https://github.com/alexsavio/rag-eval/blob/main/docs/01-hybrid-vs-rerank.md
- [statement] Do not assume more prompt context always helps: Anthropic warns about distraction, and Lost in the Middle found position-dependent degradation on multi-document QA and key-value retrieval for the models tested in 2023. (high confidence) — https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search · also: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172
- [statement] Evaluate retrieval configurations on representative queries before adopting them: tune chunk boundaries and context size, compare dense/hybrid/reranked retrieval, and assess generated-answer quality separately from retrieval metrics. (medium confidence) — https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval · keywords: RAG Patterns with Vector Search · also: https://github.com/alexsavio/rag-eval/blob/main/docs/01-hybrid-vs-rerank.md
